Pre-condition: Logged in as Asset Administrator company selected
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Assets → Asset List → click Add Asset;2. Fill all required fields: name category type brand model serial number purchase date value useful life;3. Select scope: IT Asset;4. Upload an image (JPG/PNG);5. Click Save
Expected Result: Asset is created with a unique code (e.g. AST-001). Appears in Asset List immediately.

Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Assets → Add Asset;2. Fill required fields;3. Select scope: Admin Asset;4. Click Save
Expected Result: Asset is created. Visible only under Admin scope filter.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset List;2. Click on an asset to open details;3. Click Edit;4. Change name category and value;5. Click Save
Expected Result: Changes are saved and reflected immediately in Asset List and detail view.

Pre-condition: Asset exists with no active assignments
Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset List;2. Click delete/archive on an asset;3. Confirm deletion
Expected Result: Asset is removed from active list (or archived). Confirmation message shown.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset List;2. Type partial asset code in search bar (e.g. AST-0);3. Clear and search by asset name
Expected Result: Results filter in real-time as you type. Matching assets displayed.

Pre-condition: Assets in multiple categories and statuses exist
Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset List;2. Apply category filter → select a category;3. Apply status filter → select Available;4. Apply company filter → switch company
Expected Result: List updates to show only matching assets. Filter badges/chips shown.

Pre-condition: Enough assets to span multiple pages
Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset List;2. Navigate to page 2 then page 3;3. Change page size from 10 to 25 to 50
Expected Result: Data loads correctly per page. Page indicator shows correct totals.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset List;2. Click Export → Excel
Expected Result: .xlsx file downloads with current asset list data.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset List;2. Click Export → PDF
Expected Result: PDF file downloads with formatted asset list data.

Pre-condition: Asset is in Available status. Target user exists.
Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset Assignment page;2. Select an available asset;3. Select target user;4. Set assignment date;5. Click Assign
Expected Result: Asset status changes to Assigned. User can see it in My Assets. Assignment history recorded.

Test Steps: 1. Open any assigned assets details;2. Scroll to Assignment History section
Expected Result: Complete timeline of all past assignments with dates and users.

Pre-condition: Logged in as a user with assigned assets
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to My Assets;2. Verify all assigned assets are listed;3. Click on an asset to view details
Expected Result: Only assets assigned to current user are shown. Correct statuses displayed.

Test Steps: 1. Open a browser in incognito/private mode (not logged in);2. Navigate to /assets/details/AST-001 (or similar);3. Verify public asset info is displayed
Expected Result: Public asset detail page loads with basic info (no edit/delete actions).

Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Asset Return;2. Select an assigned asset;3. Fill return reason and condition notes;4. Upload condition images (if applicable);5. Submit return request
Expected Result: Return request created with Pending status. Admin can see the request.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset Return page;2. Select multiple assets;3. Submit batch return;4. Admin processes the batch
Expected Result: All selected assets are returned in one operation. Statuses update for all.

Pre-condition: Asset is assigned to a user
Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset Transfer page;2. Select an assigned asset;3. Select receiving user/department;4. Add transfer notes;5. Submit transfer request
Expected Result: Transfer request created with Pending Approval status. Notification sent to approver.

Test Steps: 1. Log in as approver;2. Go to Approvals or Transfer Requests;3. Review pending transfer;4. Click Approve;5. Capture wet signature (if required)
Expected Result: Transfer completed. Asset reassigned to new user. Transfer form finalized.

Test Steps: 1. Log in as approver;2. Go to pending transfer request;3. Click Reject;4. Provide rejection reason
Expected Result: Transfer request rejected. Status updated. Initiator notified.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset Borrowing page;2. Select an available asset;3. Set borrow start and end dates;4. Add purpose/notes;5. Submit
Expected Result: Borrow request created. Status: Pending Approval.

Test Steps: 1. Admin approves borrow request;2. User goes to borrow requests;3. User clicks Receive to acknowledge receipt;4. Admin confirms borrower received
Expected Result: Asset marked as Borrowed. Borrow period tracked.

Test Steps: 1. User initiates return of borrowed asset;2. Admin confirms receipt;3. Verify asset status
Expected Result: Asset status returns to Available. Borrow record closed.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset Disposal page;2. Select asset for disposal;3. Fill disposal reason method date;4. Submit disposal
Expected Result: Asset status changes to Disposed. Disposal record created.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Forms → Accountability Form;2. Select assigned assets to include;3. Click Generate Form;4. Review the generated form
Expected Result: Form is generated listing all selected assets with their details. Ready for signature.

Test Steps: 1. Open the generated accountability form;2. Click Sign as Employee;3. Draw/capture digital signature;4. Confirm signature
Expected Result: Employee signature captured and saved. Form status updates.

Test Steps: 1. Log in as IT Head;2. Open the pending accountability form;3. Click Sign as IT Head;4. Draw/capture digital signature;5. Confirm signature
Expected Result: IT Head signature captured. Form is finalized. PDF available for download.

Test Steps: 1. Open a finalized (signed) accountability form;2. Click Print / Download PDF
Expected Result: PDF generates with all signatures asset list and form details visible.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Forms → Return Form;2. Select returned asset;3. Generate form;4. Employee signs;5. Admin/IT Head signs
Expected Result: Return form created and signed by both parties. PDF downloadable.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Forms → Transfer Form;2. Select completed transfer;3. Generate transfer form;4. Sender signs;5. Receiver signs;6. Admin/IT Head signs
Expected Result: Transfer form with all three signatures. PDF available.

Pre-condition: Asset exists with checklist items defined
Test Steps: 1. Go to Forms → Checklist Form;2. Select asset;3. Fill checklist items;4. Employee signs;5. Dept Head signs;6. IT Manager signs (if applicable)
Expected Result: Checklist form completed with multi-party signatures. PDF generated.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Forms → Borrow Form;2. Select completed borrow;3. Generate form;4. Borrower signs;5. Admin/approver signs
Expected Result: Borrow form created with signatures. PDF downloadable.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Approvals page;2. View all pending approvals grouped by type;3. Approve one reject another;4. Verify approval counts update
Expected Result: All pending approvals listed in one place. Approve/reject actions work. Counts refresh.

Pre-condition: Logged in as Global Admin or Admin
Test Steps: 1. Go to Users page;2. Click Add User;3. Fill required fields: name email role company;4. Set initial password;5. Click Save
Expected Result: User created. Invitation/credentials sent. User appears in user list.

Pre-condition: User exists with no special permissions
Test Steps: 1. Edit a user;2. Assign a role (e.g. IT Asset User);3. Save;4. Log in as that user;5. Verify only permitted modules are accessible
Expected Result: Users access matches the roles permission set. Restricted pages show access denied.

Test Steps: 1. Edit user permissions;2. Grant a specific permission not in their role;3. Save;4. Log in as the user;5. Verify the additional permission is active
Expected Result: Permission override works. User has both role-based and additional permissions.

Pre-condition: User is locked out due to failed login attempts
Test Steps: 1. Go to Users page;2. Find locked-out user;3. Click Remove Lockout;4. User tries logging in again
Expected Result: Lockout removed. User can log in successfully.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Settings → Asset ID Format;2. Change prefix (e.g. from AST- to CMP-);3. Save;4. Create a new asset
Expected Result: New asset uses updated ID format. Existing assets retain their old IDs.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Settings → MFA;2. Enable Require MFA for all users;3. Save;4. Log in as a different user
Expected Result: User is prompted to set up MFA (TOTP) on next login.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Settings → Security;2. Modify password policy;3. Set session timeout;4. Configure account lockout threshold;5. Save
Expected Result: Settings saved. Password policy enforced. Session times out after configured period.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Dashboard;2. Verify all chart widgets load;3. Hover over chart elements for tooltips;4. Check distribution charts
Expected Result: Dashboard loads with all charts. Data matches actual asset records.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Reports;2. Select Maintenance History report;3. Set date range and asset filter;4. Generate report;5. Export to PDF/Excel
Expected Result: Report displays with correct data. Export downloads successfully.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Reports;2. Select Finance Report;3. Select depreciation period or date range;4. Generate report
Expected Result: Financial data calculated and displayed correctly.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Audit Trail;2. Browse all audit entries;3. Filter by action type user date;4. Click on an entry for details
Expected Result: All actions logged with timestamps and user info.

Pre-condition: Audit entries exist with hash chain
Test Steps: 1. Open Audit Trail;2. Click Verify Integrity;3. Verify hash chain validation
Expected Result: Hash chain validation passes. Tamper detection confirms data integrity.

Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Intangible Assets section;2. Create a software license asset;3. Fill license key expiry date seats;4. Edit the asset;5. Delete the asset
Expected Result: Intangible asset created editable and deletable. Separate from physical assets.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset Builder;2. Create a new composite asset;3. Add component assets (child assets);4. Save;5. View composite asset details
Expected Result: Composite asset created with linked component assets. Components listed in detail view.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset Tagging page;2. Select one or more assets;3. Ensure QR toggle is selected;4. Generate tag preview;5. Print / download PDF
Expected Result: Tag preview shows company name logo and QR code. PDF prints with QR code at high resolution.

Test Steps: 1. Open phone camera or QR scanner app;2. Scan the printed QR code
Expected Result: Phone opens the public asset detail page /assets/details/<code> showing asset info.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset Tagging page;2. Select assets;3. Toggle to Barcode mode;4. Select format: CODE128;5. Generate tag preview;6. Print / download PDF
Expected Result: Tag preview shows company name and CODE128 barcode. Barcode encodes the asset code.

Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset Tagging page;2. Select assets;3. Toggle to Barcode mode;4. Select format: CODE39;5. Generate tag preview
Expected Result: Tag preview shows CODE39 barcode encoding the asset code. Different visual width vs CODE128.

Pre-condition: Printed barcode tag exists. USB barcode scanner connected.
Test Steps: 1. Have the Asset List page open and focused;2. Scan the printed barcode with the physical scanner;3. Observe system response
Expected Result: AssetViewModal opens automatically showing the correct asset. Asset code matches.

Test Scenario: Scan Barcode on My Assets Page
Pre-condition: Barcode scanner connected. Logged in as user with assigned assets.
Test Steps: 1. Go to My Assets page;2. Scan a barcode of an assigned asset
Expected Result: AssetViewModal opens with correct asset.

Pre-condition: Barcode scanner connected. On Asset Tagging page.
Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset Tagging page;2. Scan a barcode
Expected Result: AssetViewModal opens with correct asset or asset is selected for tagging.

Test Scenario: Generate Gate Pass for Single Asset
Pre-condition: Asset exists and is eligible for movement (not disposed not under repair)
Test Steps: 1. Go to Gate Pass page;2. Click New Gate Pass;3. Select a single asset;4. Fill purpose of movement destination expected return date;5. Add remarks / notes;6. Generate gate pass
Expected Result: Gate pass generated with unique reference number. Shows asset details QR/barcode movement info and date.

Test Scenario: Generate Gate Pass for Multiple Assets
Pre-condition: Multiple assets exist and are eligible for movement
Test Steps: 1. Go to Gate Pass page;2. Click New Gate Pass;3. Select multiple assets;4. Fill purpose destination expected return date;5. Generate gate pass
Expected Result: Single gate pass covers all selected assets. All asset details listed in the document.

Test Scenario: View and Print Gate Pass Document
Test Steps: 1. Go to Gate Pass list;2. Locate the generated gate pass;3. Click View to see full details;4. Click Print / Download
Expected Result: Gate pass document opens with complete details. Print/PDF output includes asset list QR/barcode signatures and movement information.

Pre-condition: Asset exists and is assigned or available
Test Steps: 1. Go to Asset Maintenance page;2. Click Add Maintenance;3. Select asset;4. Set maintenance type (preventive / corrective);5. Set scheduled date assign technician/vendor;6. Add notes and estimated cost;7. Click Save
Expected Result: Maintenance record created with Scheduled status. Asset shows as under maintenance.

Pre-condition: Maintenance record exists with Scheduled or In Progress status
Test Steps: 1. Open the pending maintenance record;2. Mark as In Progress;3. Add completion notes parts used final cost;4. Upload completion documents (if any);5. Mark as Completed
Expected Result: Maintenance record marked completed. Asset status restored to previous state.

Test Steps: 1. Open an assets detail view;2. Scroll to Maintenance History section;3. Review past maintenance entries
Expected Result: Complete history of all maintenance activities shown with dates type technician and cost.
